articleTitle: An Earthquake Emergency Command System based on GIS and RS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: As is well known, earthquake often inflicts severe casualties and property losses. The occurrence of earthquakes can not be reliably predicted by current technology, therefore the earthquake emergency and rescue is an important part of protecting against and mitigating earthquake disasters. The Earthquake Emergency Command System (EECS) helps the relief work carry through well. An EECS prototype based on the integration of Geographic Information System (GIS) and Remote Sensing (RS) is introduced in this paper. In order to enhance the stability, compatibility, efficiency and operability, the system is built based on B/S architecture. And the spatial data (vector and raster) is processed and managed by our customized tools, which preprocess the spatial data into common web picture formats (jpeg, png, gif, bmp). The preprocessed spatial data is stored in a pyramid model for faster access operations. A B/S-based data management and updating software platform is designed and implemented. The real-time post-earthquake information, which is important for emergency command decision-making, can be easily integrated and displayed in our EECS. Test results show that the prototype system is feasible and effective in real applications.

articleTitle: Research on the management information system of earthquake field based on the Internet of things
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: How to use the Internet of things technology to realize the unified management, scheduling and tracing of resources (including part of emergency rescue personnel, vehicles, equipment and so on) on the earthquake field was discussed on this paper. The Radio Frequency Identification technology (RFID) and positioning technology, which are the important parts of the Internet of things, were applied to this communication equipment management information system of earthquake field. The system would help field team leader to manage the resources on the earthquake field, and improve the use efficiency of them.

articleTitle: FTA and FMEA of braking system based on relex 2009
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Relex studio 2009 is applied in this paper to analyze the reliability problems of automotive braking system. Firstly, the components of braking system are analyzed and the reliability model is established. Secondly, the Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) is done both qualitatively and quantitatively, which helps identify the weakness to avoid accidents occurrence and minimize losses. Thirdly, the failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA) is processed. Significant data are collected including failure rate, the evaluation of failures paths and the Risk Priority Number (RPN) values. Some important conclusions are presented and serve as instructions to the braking system design.

articleTitle: Simple said about online payment risks and preventive measure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: As the change of people consumption habits and improvement of information, electronic commerce is to be one of the most popular ways in business. To promote the growth of the industry in the future are the major factors of the rapid development of the Internet in China, the consumption of the huge potential and regional advantages, etc. The network shopping with traditional shopping incomparable advantages of convenient by more and more consumer accepted and approved, after DuoNian development, a group of early network shopping the user has to network shopping for center formed a new way of life. The online payment is a form of electronic payment, it is through the third party to provide with Banks to pay the interface between the immediate payment. In view of present e-commerce transactions online payment meet safety risk, analyzed, and put forward the corresponding solution countermeasures and measures.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the relationship between energy consumption and economic growth in Heilongjiang province
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Energy is the essential material foundation of economic and social development for the subsistence and development of human beings. Nowadays, various countries are suffering from energy crisis which restricts economic development. This paper is based on the energy consumption and GDP data of Heilongjiang province from 1980 to 2009 of using unit root test, cointegration analysis and Granger causality test, aiming at validating the relationship between Heilongjiang energy consumption and economic growth. Empirical analysis shows that energy consumption can be strongly driven by economic growth, however, energy consumption plays a relative small role on promoting economic growth, and then this paper puts forward countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Evolution mechanism analysis on internet public opinion of enterprise crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Public opinion spreads very quickly at network times. The positive public opinion can bring remarkable social benefit and economic benefit, but the negative public opinion will affect the development of enterprises, even the survival of the enterprise. So it is very important how to control public opinion for enterprises. This paper analysizes connotation, evolution subject, propagation way, evolution progress on Internet public opinion of enterprise crisis events in information era. At the same time, it is studied how modern enterprise handle correctly propagation and development about Internet public opinion because of crisis events and how enterprise get rid of negative effects, set up positive image, and minimize the enterprise's loss. As a result, this paper puts forward strategies as the reference for enterprise decision-making.

articleTitle: A Bayesian network model for the Asian Games fire risk assessment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In order to assess the fire risk of the gymnasiums, the assigned hospitals and hotels for 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games, a Bayesian network (BN) fire risk assessment model was developed. The BN model consists of 45 nodes that are divided into four subnetworks: fire safety management, fire-fighting facilities, evacuation and fire hazard assessment. The fire safety management subnetwork specifies the influence of fire safety management on fire risks; the fire-fighting facilities subnetwork predicts the working conditions of fire-fighting facilities; the evacuation subnetwork simulates the required safety egress time; and the fire hazard assessment subnetwork predicts fire hazard results based on the results of above three subnetworks. Important risk factors due to the features of the Asian Games include security funding, police reinforcement, secondary and derivative events. The model was applied to 50 gymnasiums, 57 hotels, 35 hospitals and 2 congregations (opening and closing ceremony) before the Asian Games, and the assessment results were used in reducing and controlling fire risks. The practical working procedure of the Asian Games fire risk assessment work is also presented. The application of this model shows that it not only can perform fire risk assessment but also can conduct fast disaster situation assessment based on observational data during a fire.

articleTitle: Integration of the post-earthquake casualty estimation model and GIS platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In 20th century and in early 21st century, there were some massive earthquakes happened in China. Rapid and accurate estimation and assessment of casualties caused by earthquake is essential basis for government and administrators to initialize the appropriate level of emergent plan. In this paper, a casualty prediction system for earthquake based on geographic information system has been developed. The system has integrated the population distribution information, Geodata, building vulnerability information, and it can give a quick estimation of possible casualties caused by the earthquake through successful application of geographic information system. The system can give reasonable estimation of earthquake casualty. The visualized output data will be helpful for the disastrous consequences analysis and decision making.

articleTitle: The effects of brand crisis on brand evaluation and consumer's willingness of brand relationship rebuilding: The moderating effect of self-image congruence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Nowadays, enterprises are more likely to encounter brand crises. Once brand crises happen, consumers tend to have a negative evaluation on the brand. Different types of brand crisis will lead to different damage to brand evaluation. Compared to passive brand crises, initiative brand crises will make consumers have much more negative evaluation on the brand. Consumer's self-image congruence will moderate the relationship between brand crisis and brand evaluation. If the self-image congruence is high, the negative evaluation will be small; if the self-image congruence is low, the negative evaluation will be relatively large. Brand evaluation will mediate the relationship between brand crisis and consumer's willingness of brand relationship rebuilding. In this paper, experimental method is used to verify all the hypotheses.

Author Keywords: Consumer's willingness of brand relationship rebuilding

articleTitle: Research of fire predicting model based association rule data mining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Some countries in the world have different the degree of fires every year, it caused the serious damage to the ecological environment, not only losing huge resources, but wasting a lot of manpower and material resources. A new approach to forecast fire information is presented in this paper, which will provide efficient theoretical support and technical guidance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of reliability on LCC of warship
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The reliability of the warship system is very important to reducing its life cycle cost. By analyzing the effect of reliability on LCC of warship and setting up the model of the effect of reliability on LCC of warship. An example shows that the model can reflect the effect of reliability on LCC of warship effectively and have guidance significance to optimize the reliability indexes.

articleTitle: Research on the risk of economic responsibility audit and its prevention—Based on the measurement of the rate of the achievement in the leaders' official career
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: According to the special feature called “review things and examine people” of the economic responsibility audit, the economic responsibility audit of the leaders is based on the consideration of the dynamic change of the achievement of the audited-object in his organization. It is proposed that we can indirectly evaluate the economic behavior effectiveness of the leaders and evade the risk of the economic responsibility audit by means of the rate of the achievement of the leader in his organization. This paper uses the output-oriented DEA model to calculate the overall indicators and takes advantage of the method of the binary relative efficiency to calculate the relative progress rate of the overall score beyond the year, in order to overcome the environmental differences of the effects made on the performance of the audited-object and be combined with the complexity of the economic responsibility audit, which can be taken as the objective indicator of the economic behavior effectiveness of the leader in the audited organization. Compared to the absolute progress rate by the ratio of the current indicator to that of the base period, this paper use the binary relative evaluation and the indicator of individual relative differences to measure the relative progress rate, which is good at the self-evaluation and self-development of the leader in order to truly reflex the effective progress of the quality of the leadership behavior in groups.

articleTitle: Assessment of emergency capacity to major public incidents on urban subway
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The urban subway emergencies of the world took place frequently which would cause great casualties and property loss, as well as unfavorable political influence on public security and stability, so far as to cause the social panic. The paper explains the concepts of public emergency and the mutations mechanism and features of urban subway emergency. It undertakes an evaluation by means of Analytic Hierarchy Process and Fuzzy Mathematics which are effective to evaluate the whole process of emergency management. Then the paper presents a case study about the emergency especially its development tendency of one subway in China. At last the paper gives conclusions about the assessment of emergency capacity to major public incidents on urban subway, which is full of significances to other public incidents.

articleTitle: The comprehensive evaluation system for meteorological disasters emergency management capability based on the entropy-weighting TOPSIS method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: According to “People's Republic of Emergency Response Act” issued in 2007, this paper is committed to construct the indices system of meteorological disasters emergency management capability. The indices system consists of five parts, which are disasters monitoring capability, disasters prevention capability, residents emergency preparedness capability, emergency response capability, post-disaster recovery capability. This paper improves the TOPSIS method by using entropy-weighting, and then establishes evaluation model of meteorological disasters emergency management capability. This model can solve the multi-index evaluation problem, and has a good effect. Hence, this paper does empirical research on the China's 31 provinces (municipalities and autonomous regions). The empirical results show that this built model for evaluating meteorological disasters emergency management capacity is strongly operational and practical.

articleTitle: Study on industry safety problem influenced by transnational investment and its countermeasures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Under the influence of economic globalization, transnational investment has improved the development of China's economy. At the same time, it arouses numbers of problems, conflicts and crises. Local industry is suffering an attack which even appears industry safety problems. On the basis of references, it can be concluded that only by deeply understanding the reasons why transnational corporations impact China passively in some aspects can we propose corresponding solutions. Therefore, this essay analyzed the trend of operation model and summed up the negative impact on China's industrial safety and proposed corresponding solutions at last.

articleTitle: The game analysis of coal mining enterprises safe-production and government administration re-supervision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: As we all know, coal is an important basic resource which accounts for about 70% in the primary energy structure. Coal mining enterprises have the primary responsibility of the mine accident. Therefore, it is a great significance with researching the production strategy of coal mining enterprises. In this paper, we use the game theory to analyze the interest between safe-production of the coal mining enterprises and the government administration re-supervision. And we also analyze the cause of coal mine safety accidents. Through analyzing, a conclusion comes out that the innovation of supervision system is the key to improve the situation of coal mining production, we should establish including the media, associations and other third-party monitoring mechanism and government and enterprises should strengthen the training of miners safety education.

articleTitle: The risk monitoring of coal construction project based on system dynamics model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The construction project of coal mine is characterized by onetime, high cost, long duration, difficult construction, technical complexity and multitudinous project participants, whose risk events occur frequently in its construction. Therefore, the risk monitoring of construction project of coal mine is of theoretical significance and practical value. The risk control problems of coal mine construction project were studied from two aspects in the paper: First of all, the organizational framework and process of risk monitoring about coal mine construction project are built; Secondly, the issues about the risk monitoring of construction project of coal mine are dynamically and quantitatively researched through the establishment of system dynamics model.

articleTitle: On crisis management of enterprises in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: It is no overstatement to say that crisis seems to be unstable and may outbreak whenever and wherever possible. There is a growing awareness that enterprises will be greatly threatened as the increase of the fierce market competition. Various kinds of crisis events give rise to the test of blood and fire towards enterprises. Consumers' trust, brand reputation and even market share which are built up laboriously by enterprises may eventually collapse during this test. Therefore, we must be mindful of the potential danger and stay prepared against adversities in times of peace. Not only has this article expounded the connotation of crisis management of the enterprise, but has analyzed the current status of crisis management of the enterprise in China as well, let alone the specific measures of the enterprise crisis management according to the actual circumstances. Thorough crisis management mechanism is definitely the key for the enterprises to keep their heads above water. Finally, in the crisis there lie opportunities, which must be seized by all means.

articleTitle: The calculation of component failure probability in the seismic PSA using Monte Carlo sampling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: According to the experience in Probabilistic safety assessment (PSA) studies of operating NPPs, one of the most important external events affecting NPP safety is earthquakes. The seismic PSA evaluates the risks of severe accidents at nuclear power plants (NPPs) caused by seismic events. Now the Seismic PSA model has been developed for the reference plant. In the study, the code was developed using Monte Carlo sampling, and then the uncertainty analysis of component failure probability was carried out in the seismic PSA. It can be found that the component failure probability in seismic has large uncertainty. And for the simultaneous failure of multi-component caused by earthquake, the failure probability was contributed mainly by the stronger component.

articleTitle: Research on construction of small and medium-sized enterprise crisis management system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: China's SME have to build a scientific crisis management system under the context of knowledge economy era in economic globalization and international competition. SME crisis management system consists of three parts: warning management system mechanism-based of prevention to early pre-crisis, control processing system, whose core is to communicate when a crisis occurs, recovery management system to summarize and assess the post-crisis. Specifically, SME crisis management system should include early warning subsystem, pre-control subsystem, the processing subsystem, subsystems and recovery subsystem summary. At the same time, specific measures of crisis management system operation should be made to promote SME. Through establishing an effective enterprise risk management systems and effective crisis management mechanism, SME can reduce the intensity and the scope of crisis, and minimize the losses caused by the crisis coming.

articleTitle: Research on demand transmission process risk management of supply chain based on fractal theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The demand transmission process manegement is an important part of supply chain management. In comparing the current transmission process, the integrated demand transmission process has more advantages than others, but it also faces a series of risks. Because of the information-sharing platform, internal and external demand for effective integration, rigorous mechanisms in fractal reengineering demand transmission process, fractal reengineering demand transmission can effectivley prevente and control the demand transmission risk. According to this, not only the fractal reengineering method for the demand transmission process was put forward based on fractal theory, but also the first and second fractal reengineering structure of demand transmission process were given in details. Finally, the proposals of matching mechanisms of using fractal reengineering process to manage the demand transmission risk were given.

articleTitle: Emergency materials dispatching considering reverse logistics in view of simulation optimization approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: A simulation optimization method is proposed to realize the optimal planning on the dispatching of emergency materials. Firstly, the formulation of mathematical programming model considering reverse logistics is established, and the optimal objective is to minimize the cost of the emergency system and ensure to satisfy the time constraint of the demand points in the disaster areas. Secondly, the emergency materials dispatching simulation model is built using the object-oriented method. At last, the simulation optimization method integrating the simulation model and the genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of emergency materials dispatching, and the effectiveness and efficiency are verified and analyzed through an actual example. The result shows its feasibility for the emergency materials optimal dispatching.

articleTitle: A framework for earthquake disaster mitigation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: China is an earthquake-prone country, and it is also one of the most serious earthquake disaster countries in the world. Establishment and improvement of earthquake disaster mitigation systems, integrating existing earthquake information and avoiding islands of information, has great significance to reduce the adverse impact on the country and the people. A more complete architecture of the earthquake disaster mitigation system based on computer and system engineering is put forward in this paper, considering the data flow in the work of earthquake disaster reduction. The architecture includes four levels: data collection level, data processing level, data application level and data presentation level. At the same time this paper describes the system design principles, organizational framework, functions. Finally the paper summarizes some problems which need pay more attention and focus on in the system building process.

articleTitle: Analysis on earthquake loss compensation system from Japan
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Earthquake is one of the serious disasters which may induce heavy casualties and economic losses. Japan is a country with frequent earthquake disasters. Administrative authority for disaster management in Japan covers the central government, local governments and public institutions. Earthquake insurance has become the important way to manage significant disastrous risk in Japan. As a socialized system for disaster loss dispersal, insurance against earthquake does not play a role in China. Financial aid from Government makes the main body of loss compensation system. Commercial insurance coverage does not play a role in bear disaster loss. Victims take main loss in disaster. After analyzing current earthquake insurance model and investigating practice from Japan for reference, it reveals that construction of earthquake risks diversification relies on inevitability of government function changed, improvement of insurance market and emphasis the demotic consciousness in China.

articleTitle: Food safety regulation and Governance - based on the tripartite game of regulatory authorities, government officials and food industries
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Information asymmetry exists in the whole process of food safety supply chain in food market. There is a game relation among regulatory departments, government officials and food industries in the protecting and supervising of food safety. The market equilibrium depend on the strategy of regulatory departments, government officials and food industries. Through the construction of triple static game models, this paper proposes that we should assess the need/justification for food safety regulation, relationships between public and private food safety control systems, alternative forms that public food safety regulation can take strategic responses to food safety regulation, and the trade implications of national food safety controls.

articleTitle: Impact of perceived risk on purchase intention in product-harm crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The perceived risk plays an important role in customers' buying decision. For increasing the customer's purchase intention ,decreasing the customer's perceived risk is the most usual way. Most of the previous researches related with the perceived risk focused on the normal buying environment, while this article mainly discusses the specific dimensions of the perceived risk including: financial risk, function risk, the body risk, the social risk and the psychological risk which have significant influence on the customer's purchase intention in the context of the product-harm crisis, thus validated the hypothesis that the perceived risk were made of the above five dimensions and made targeted marketing suggestions for enterprises to deal with the product-harm crisis.

articleTitle: Reliability prediction and Markov analysis of braking system based on Relex 2009
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: To analyze the reliability of automobile braking system, the reliability module and Markov module of Relex studio 2009 are adopted in this paper. Firstly, braking system is analyzed systematically, including function, braking process, components. Then Competitive failure models are identified and reliability model is established. Failure rate of each subsystem is obtained using the reliability prediction. According to the reliability prediction results, Markov transfer model and data are presented. This indicated that the Markov result is consistent to the prediction module. This study provides instructiveness through design and operations of braking system.

articleTitle: Research on customer segmentation based on OCA cluster ensemble in customer crisis management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: At present, single cluster model is adopted usually for customer segmentation. In this paper, clustering ensemble technology is applied to customer segmentation improves the cluster performance in customer crisis management owing to the uncertainty and fuzziness of customer behavior. First, this paper regards objective cluster analysis ( OCA ) as basic clusterer, which overcomes the shortcoming that current traditional customer segmentation methods cannot determine the number of clusters objectively, and then use a co-occasion matrix to combine the multiple clusterings to obtain the final consensus clustering. Finally, experiments show that the objective clustering ensemble algorithm based on random projection not only improves the accuracy of customer segmentation, but also finds out the optional clustering scheme in an automatic and objective way.

articleTitle: Establishment and application of comprehensive evaluation system for the ability of post-disaster recovery and reconstruction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mechanism of post-disaster recovery and reconstruction. Based on it, this paper constructs the index system for the ability of recovery and reconstruction. The index system includes two aspects which are restoration of living and disaster area reconstruction. And then it also establishes the improved unascertained measure model to analysis the recovery and reconstruction ability. This model uses quintile grading method to overcome traditional model's limitation, that is only can evaluate “fuzzy mathematical problem for grades”. Meanwhile, it also improves model accuracy by using the DIDF method. Hence, this paper does empirical analysis for China's 31 provinces (municipalities and autonomous regions). And the results as follows: Firstly, most of the regions ranking at the top are economically developed areas, such as Beijing, Shanghai and Tianjin. Secondly, the regions of ranking at the end are mainly central and western regions, such as Guizhou, Guangxi. Thirdly, the rankings can provide scientific decision-making basis for government departments in practice.

articleTitle: The impact of deregulation reform to the growth of China's natural gas industry-A panel data analysis from 1986–2008
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: China has implemented the oil and gas industry reforms in 1998, but there is few quantitative analysis on the performance of deregulation reform. We construct two econometric models - the profit model and the efficiency model, select 1986–2008 years data as a sample, use co-integration analysis including the structural breaks, we shows that deregulation dummy variables have a significant impact for industry profits and efficiency through the unit root test to original time series, then confirmed that deregulation of China's oil and gas industry not only introduced the competition but also improved industrial performance.

articleTitle: Research on joint emergency responses to industrial accidents of enterprises in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: To improve effectiveness of emergency responses to industrial accidents, this paper studied how effective emergency responses were achieved inside and outside of enterprises. Based on the barriers of joint emergency responses to information sharing and emergency linkages, this paper analyzed the cause based on FBF and proposed policy solutions for joint emergency responses to industrial accidents of enterprises. The policy solutions included four aspects, i.e. to establish emergency management agencies, to construct emergency coordination mechanisms, to release relevant legal systems of joint emergency responses, and to stipulate regulations of joint emergency responses. The barriers including poor flow of emergency information and weak linkages of emergency responses, can be attackled by the policy solutions. Therefore, government and enterprises will perform joint emergency responses effectively.

articleTitle: Research on government responsibilities in natural disasters management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Complexity of landforms in China makes natural disasters happen constantly. Recently China has done much successful work in rescue of natural disasters. However, we still have a long way to go, as there still lays a great deal of problems in. We can establish lawful framework combining basic law with single laws, set up a unified and specialized agency for natural disaster management, develop a perfect system of natural disasters management and so forth. Through these suggestions, the author hopes that they might improve capability in dealing with natural disasters, reduce losses and bring to the public citizens so as to protect people's lives and property. Only in these ways, we can maintain the stability and development of society.

articleTitle: Preliminary evaluation of the effect of several management measures for the station blackout severe accident of the pressurized water reactor nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The recent Fukushima accident shows that for nuclear power plants, station blackout (SBO) is an important cause of core damage severe accident and radiological releases. In this paper, the typical three-loop pressurized water reactor (PWR) in China is modeled using an integrated severe accident analysis code, and the progression of the SBO accident sequence is also simulated. Then based on the analysis of the calculation results, several measures are adopted to mitigate the SBO accident. In spite of some negative effects, the analysis results show that the consequences of SBO severe accident can be effectively mitigated by restoration of the AC power supply, rapid depressurization of the primary system by opening the three safety valves, and feeding water into the steam generators.

articleTitle: The risk assessment of urban hail damage on automobiles in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The hail disaster occur frequently in China, with the rapid growth of the holding of the automobiles, more and more scholars began to pay attention to the hail damage to automobiles. Based on the hail database (1949–2008) of 258 cities in China, the risk assessment of urban hail damage to automobiles was carried out by using the GIS technology and disaster system theory, and the map of hail hazards rank, the map of automobiles vulnerability rank, as well as the map of hail risk to automobiles were outlined. The result indicates: (1) The highly dangerous cities are distributed in Yangtze River Delta Area and around BoHai Sea area, while the Pearl River Delta area is relatively low. (2) The vulnerability of cities in the Eastern Region is higher than the Western Part. (3) Thirty-three cities are in the high risk rank, accounting for 12% of Chinese cities, which mainly concentrate in Yangtze River Delta Area and around BoHai Sea area. This research may provides the scientific basis for insurance company in hail damage on automobiles.

articleTitle: Research on WBS-based risk identification and the countermeasures for real estate projects' entire course
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Real estate is a typical industry with high risk, and the real estate project development has the attribution of huge investment, long construction period and is vulnerable to the environmental interference. It is critical to achieve risk identify and strengthen risk management for real estate projects. The paper will apply the method of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) from scope management of project management to make factor analysis on the real estate projects' entire course for quality management. We will breakdown the entire real estate projects' course into separate phases. They are the start-up phase, design and planning phase, implementation phase and final phase. Then we will identify the primary types and reasons of risks existed and put forward some corresponding countermeasures and suggestions in order to achieve risk management control for the real estate projects' entire course.

articleTitle: Brand relationship: A new perspective on brand crisis management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Based on the nature of brand relationship, it's a new perspective on brand crisis management to explore what kind of impacts the interactive relationship between consumers and brands would have on brand crisis. From the perspective of brand relationship, this paper defines brand as a state of the severe distortion and even temporary or permanent dissolution of brand relationship caused by widely spread negative incidents and puts forward an idea that brand crisis is a dynamic and evolutionary process which may be divided into three circulating phases: latency, outbreak and recovery. Brand relationship quality (BRQ) may be evaluated to judge which phase brand crisis is in, thus helping corporations accurately identify brand crisis, scientifically prevent and cope with crisis, better learn about crisis, and reduce the losses to the lowest.

Author Keywords: New perspective on brand crisis management

articleTitle: Constructing industry safety evaluation system under the influence of transnational corporations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Based on fully understanding the impacts on industry safety made by transnational corporations, this essay will try to design new evaluation system with absorbing the essence of former industry evaluation system which will analyze in four parts: industry environment, industry competitiveness, industry dependence, industry control.

articleTitle: Earthquake influence on social economy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Based on the large reference of the relevant research, the social disaster of earthquake and their influence on development of regional economy are analyzed. It is thought that the disaster and its social influence are more serious and it's effected scope become larger than before. Most of case suggested that earthquake have an obvious long run effect on local economic development. It will directly or indirectly influent one region's economy development. Economy background and disaster reduction measures decide the disaster bearing abilities. The developed countries' ability to withstand hazard is stronger than developing ones. Because invest more on mitigation measures, the investment on social reproduction would be limited, so earthquake would deduce the profits of economy and slow down the development speed, and in the end affects the sustainable development of regional economy.

articleTitle: The construction and hierarchical analysis of the emergency ability system for the production of enterprise
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The production emergency ability system is one important part of improving emergency management level, it is the effecting result of the emergency ability supply and demand, and it also is the outcome of the joint effect of the internal and external environment of emergency surroundings. The production emergency ability system is constructed based on the theory of enterprise ability and emergency ability management, and thoughts of systematology. The enterprise obtains some emergency benefit and achieves emergency targets under the combination effect of the internal and external environment, and the input of emergency resources. In this paper, the emergency ability is divided by latent state and show state, and the enhancement of the emergency ability must experience a process from latent to show. Some important managerial insights are obtained, which are useful for the guidance in the scientific ability management of enterprise emergency system and social administration department.

Author Keywords: Model of matching supply and demand

articleTitle: Evolution of group network behavior on the internet in a public crisis and its control measures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In recent years China has seen public crises take place very frequently. Public crises can cause panic to the public and severely affect people's study, work and living. Especially in an Internet environment, the openness, fastness, its great capacity to transmit and gather information of the Internet is an epoch-making. As a part of group behaviors in a public crisis, group network behavior is more and more pointing up the development trend of a crisis. Facts are enumerated and analyses are made in this paper, which aims to give a deep analysis of the causes, the development and the law of evolution of group network behavior using the examples of public crisis cases and relevant data. It tries to identify the obstacles to the use of Internet information by the public in a public crisis. Through the analysis of the influence and the role of these factors in a public crisis, this paper attemps to propose measures for controling and guiding group network behaviors in a public crisis.

articleTitle: Development of an interpretive structural model of factors in emergency materials support
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Earthquake emergency materials support is crucial to the efficiency of earthquake emergency response and at the same time, provides the material basis for emergency rescue to carry out smoothly. This paper identifies the related factors in earthquake emergency materials support firstly, using literature review as the research basis. Further an interpretive structural modeling (ISM) technique has been used to develop a structural model to obtain a proper hierarchy and interrelationship among these factors. This model will allow clear visualization of these factors' hierarchy relationships and help to prioritize the factors which require different strategies respectively to improve the whole emergency materials support system. The relationship hierarchy serves as a useful reference for further enhancing the ability of emergency material supplies and improving the systems of emergency materials support.

articleTitle: Hull subsection production crisis early warning system design based on the KPI
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The KPI theory in hull subsection production information management system software is very suitable. At present, enterprises make use of the hull section information management system software to focus only on progress monitoring; it is deficient in crisis early warning. The paper will design a hull subsection production crisis early warning management information system based on KPI, Expanding the hull subsection production information management system functions, making the early-warning mechanism more perfect, and thus it is more timely and effective for managers to take preventive measures to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Technologies on establishing earthquake site communication network based on wireless mesh network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The earthquake site communication technologies are very important for the post-earthquake emergency and rescue work, with high requirements for convenient setup and stable data transmission. According to the real requirements, methods to establish the earthquake site communication network based on wireless mesh network (WMN) are proposed in this paper. A WMN is a special type of wireless ad hoc network and supports various wireless protocols. Some key issues (architecture, capacity, radio techniques, scalability, security, etc.) of WMN are discussed. On the basis of summarizing different applications supported by WMNs, an earthquake site communication network based on WMN is established. In such an application, various Wi-Fi clients are connected together and consequently facilitate the earthquake site rescue work. The methods are proved feasible and meaningful for real earthquake emergency and rescue work.

articleTitle: The study of seismic margins evaluation methodology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The objective of a seismic margin review of a plant is to determine if the plant can safely withstand an earthquake larger than the design-basis earthquake (DBE), namely the safe shutdown earthquake (SSE). In the mid-1980s, two different methodologies for the seismic margin assessment (SMA) of nuclear power plants were developed. One was developed by the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) (EPRI Method) and another was developed by the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) (NRC Method). This paper studied the SMA method, and has applied it in the passive nuclear plant. Practice show that compared with the NRC method and EPRI method, the AP1000 method is more convenient and operational.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of hydraulic characteristics of coolant in rod spacer grids
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Thermal hydraulic performance analysis of fuel rod bundle with spacer grids takes important role among the pressure water reactor (PWR) design and safety operation. Due to its intrinsic complex geometric configuration, previous studies were almost based on one-dimensional code and many simplifications had to be made to make simulations manageable. In the present paper, the intact and simplified spacer grids were simulated and analyzed by using the Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD) software, and efforts were emphasized on the influence factors on the flow field including spacer grids with mixing vanes only and spacer grids with mixing vanes springs and dimples, respectively. The results indicate that the springs and dimples have great influences on the flow field and thus cannot be neglected during numerical simulation of coolant flow through subchannels with spacer grids. The transverse flows and pressure drop with springs and dimples show more intense than those without spacer and dimples as expected.

articleTitle: A study on the basic conditions for human survivor in enclosed environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: To reduce casualties caused by the underground coal mining accidents, the experiment studies the basic conditions for human survivor in movable refuge chamber through the simulated enclosed underground environment. By conducting this experiment and testing subjects under the different physical circumstance in enclosed environment, we have learned the relationship between heart rate and breathing rate, and conclude that each adult man consumes 934.20mL of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and breathes out 934.20mL of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Therefore, we can confirm the different carrying capacity (the amount of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and the amount soda lime to absorb CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) can be used in the refuge chamber. The experiment results can be also provide reference for the arrangement of ventilators study.

articleTitle: Public food safety pre-warning system of crisis management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: There are several problems exist in the field of Chinese food safety at present: food safety system and command system of crisis management is imperfect. This thesis analyzes the reason that led to the malfunction and inefficient status of food safety crisis management of China. It mainly focusing on problems of overlapping functions; overstaffing; stagnant information changing; inadequate legal protection; poor quality officers; obstructions of restriction in trade association; lacking of food security and social responsibility conscious; low participation of public and media between different departments. Based on all of above, we construct the pre-warning system of Chinese food safety crisis. At the same time, we put forward to China's food safety crisis countermeasures. At last the topic research result is concluded.

articleTitle: Research on Crisis information broadcast mode in we-media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Crisis information broadcast is researched in this paper. Compared with traditional media, characters of we-media are summarized. Information broadcast mode is instructed. Three critical points are highlighted. As a result, countermeasures are issued as crisis monitor, crisis control and crisis recovery.

articleTitle: Research on the banking organizational operation crisis management in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Financial problems are not only a significant research topic in the field of crisis management, but they also influence people's daily life and the operation of enterprises. To the great extent, finance crisis severely affects social stability and economic development and has a profound negative influence over the entire world. At present, China's banking industry has come to a critical juncture, how to control risks and grasp opportunities becomes the significant and urgent topic. Our banks also face an overwhelming amount of problems such as improper resource allocation, increasing bad loans, unreasonable operation and so forth. With the assistance of Process Operation Management theories and practices, this paper, from the perspective of crisis management and combined with the organizational operations, aims to analyze the banking problems of the operation situation. This paper will research the service blueprint concept and the service profit concept, and then make a range of suggestions on the effectiveness of banking organizational operations, which can be helpful to banking operation.

articleTitle: An incomplete information-theoretic study of the optimization of stripping non-performance assets caused by the Energy Enterprise Crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In accordance with the characteristics of non-performance asset results from the Energy Enterprise Crisis, this paper conducts the routing optimizing module of stripping non-performance assets resulting from the Energy Enterprise Crisis under incomplete information within Incomplete Information Theory. This paper establishes the integrated optimization module and outlines the decision methods and implementation steps for the module. This paper will provide evidence for decision-making regarding the maintenance and stable increase of the value of uncertain assets in an enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on relationship between public security and economic growth in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The econometric model which reflects the relationship between economic growth and public security in China was established in order to analyze the evolution law and trends of public security based on the time series data from 1991 to 2009.The simulation result reflects that the EKC presents an N-shaped curve instead of a U-shaped which means public emergency frequency would first increase, and decline, and then increase, with the rapid increase of GDP per capita. The trend would appear repeatedly and finally decline. According to the statistic result, the current state of public security would be worsening with the growth of economic in China. As a result, it is necessary to sum up the experience and advance the adoption of appropriate preventive measures. The Economic growth should be accompanied by a good public security circumstance.

articleTitle: Analysis on the development of China's financial derivative market under the background of financial crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The current financial crisis causes many disputes on whether and how to develop China's financial derivative market. Financial derivatives are only links in the complex chain of transmission. They should not assume main responsibilities although some researchers described the financial crisis as “derivatives flooding”. By comparative analysis on development stages, market-driven mechanism, product range and market scale and economic base and financial base of financial derivative market, we conclude that China's financial derivative market is still in the elementary stage. It develops very slowly and still has great development potential. China should develop construction for basic financial derivative markets and establish a multilevel market structure gradually for the financial derivative market. Improve formation mechanism of RMB exchange rate and market RMB interest rate. Establish sound regulatory systems and risk prevention and control systems for the financial derivative market. China's commercial banks should improve core competitiveness of financial derivatives and enhance management abilities for risks.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of agricultural drought in Inner Mongolia based on information diffusion technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In recent years, agricultural drought in our country has become more serious year by year and caused huge economic losses. In regard to agricultural drought risk research, the traditional statistics model is not high enough for the precision of risk of Assessment of Agricultural Drought because of lack of enough information of historical disasters recorded. Considering of this limit, the fuzzy risk assessment model is introduced according to the information of diffusion principle. This model has the advantages of being able to optimally solve the assessment problems. With few samples reflect of the fuzzy uncertainty property of risk assessment, this model has been applied to assess the drought index since 1997 in Inner Mongolia and the results indicate that the Agriculture drought happens every year, the drought index is mainly concentrated from 5% to 60%, and the occurrence probability above 20% is 91.67%, which suited the true situations. The results have significant guidance for stopping the drought.

articleTitle: Research on public's perception of risk propagation process of nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Presently, China has proved a remarkable progress in nuclear power, under which circumstance this paper is written to make a study about the consequences and influences of two well-known nuclear accidents in history by way of questionnaire. Having analyzed the public's cognition about the risks of nuclear industry, the author concludes that as the crisis spread, the information content will reduce or increase. Besides, a correction coefficient is also put forward to revise the risk formula frequently used in engineering. Finally, the crisis management is proposed for controlling coefficient in field of nuclear power.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation model of public crisis internet information diffusion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The paper analyzed the connotation about public crisis internet information diffusion, and built a simulation model of that. On the basis of choosing the platform of simulation model, the settings of simulation experiment were discussed. By changing the parameters, it analyzed different results and reasons, and at last reached 5 valuable conclusions, that is, First, public crisis internet information diffuse very fast. Second, public crisis internet information diffusion has inherent regularity. Third, group polarization phenomenon exists in public crisis internet information diffusion process. Fourth, the credibility of the original information has important impact on the result of public crisis internet information diffusion. Fifth, the time government publishing crisis information and the supervision and guidance of government are important to diffusion results.

articleTitle: Based on multiple linear regression analysis of the macroeconomic factors affecting real estate prices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of certain market prices of commercial housing supply and demand factors and policy factors, and use of our 1999 and 2010 sample data to establish the commercial housing price factor econometric model of the model results show that the level of real estate development and urban residents' income investment in real estate prices is the impact of the main factors based on this, that in recent years, housing prices of goods have a certain inevitability and rationality, but the Government still controlled by raising the income level of a reasonable size and population continue to increase the livelihood of the urban infrastructure and other measures to stabilize prices of commercial housing.

articleTitle: Crisis management for oil spill at sea in Hainan province
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: With the accelerated construction pace of the international traveling island, Hainan province will have another golden period of development and opportunity for its socio-economic since the establishment of Hainan. However, the protection of environmental resources is an important guarantee for building a sustainable development international traveling island. Currently, there are a variety of potential environment risks in Hainan and the oil spills risk is the most important one. This article summarizes the main potential risks for oil spills in Hainan. Based on these potential risks, we use some methods to analyze them. At last, some reasonable suggestions will be put out in order to help the government of Hainan to make decisions and develop contingency plans about oil spills at sea.

articleTitle: Inspiration for the dividing of emergency planning zone from Fukushima nuclear accident
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: After Fukushima accident, people come to realize that multiunit accidents may happen even though the risk is very low. In order to enhance nuclear safety standards and protect the public and environment, it's necessary to consider the impact on emergency planning zone by multiunit accidents. Based on the requirement of general optimized intervention level prescribed by GB 18871, this article calculates the range of emergency planning zone in case of different number of units in accordance with the assumption of multiunit accidents, and then gives some recommendations of the standard in dividing emergency planning zone according to the calculation results. If considering the risk of multiunit accidents, maybe it's necessary to adjust the corresponding national standards, increase the range of inside plume emergency planning zone and properly adjust the range of outside emergency planning zone.

articleTitle: Study on food safety crisis management in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Not only food safety is a direct bearing on people's physical health and safety, but also it severely affects the stability of the economic and social development. At present Chinese food market faces the grime situation with continuous food safety incidents. Therefore, it is the problem urgently to be solved for the government to deal with public food safety crisis. By describing the concepts and effects of food safety crisis, and analyzing the causes of the food safety crisis, food safety are divided into three stages, and the paper points out the present proposals for construction of food safety crisis management system in China and puts forward the response to improve the food safety crisis management.

articleTitle: Discussion on emergency response of fire department in “5.12 Wenchuan” Earthquake
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The rescue mission to “5.12 Wenchuan” Earthquake is the first time for Chinese fire control forces to carry out an operation that lasts a long period, covers a large scale and crosses over many regions and areas. To a certain extent, it is a test on the rescue capabilities of the fire control forces. In this article, the performances of Fire Corps of Guizhou Province in the rescue operations are summarized, followed by the description on the problems they met. At last, the measures and suggestion to increase the rescue capabilities are presented from the perspectives of team building, training, psychological recovery, and supplying system.

articleTitle: Research on residential environment planning and design in the post-earthquake reconstruction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: According to the analysis and the research on the residential environment concept and methods of the planning and design of the modern residential environment, it discusses residential environment planning and design scheme in the reconstruction after earthquake disasters. The article also points out that it should make the residential environment planning and design from such aspects as the reconstruction sites, the planning system, local culture, building and environment design, psychological reconstruction, and thus establishes good social and cultural environment so as to improve people's quality of their lives. At the same time, it briefly reviews the organization approach and overall ideas of the Wenchuan earthquake reconstruction planning. And some basic methods and strategies of the recovery are discussed in the article.

articleTitle: The evolution of brand crisis based on brand relationship
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The previous studies about the evolution of brand crisis are mainly based on enterprise management perspective. This paper tries to study the evolution of brand crisis on the perspective of brand relationship. On the basis of literature study, brand crisis cycle is divided into three stages: Latency, Outbreak and Recovery. Collecting datas through experimental method, the paper concludes the following conclusions: firstly, Outbreak has the lowest commitment / relevance degree and belonging / attention degree in the evolution; secondly, there is no difference in trust / respect degree between Recovery and Outbreak; lastly, association / recognition degree doesn't change significantly in brand crisis cycle. Based on the above results, the paper gives some suggestions on how to deal with brand crisis in various stages of the evolution.

articleTitle: How to protect brand relationship quality in corporate crisis by appropriate communication strategy?—Moderating effect of consumer psychological contract
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Many factors affect brand relationship quality in corporate crisis, crisis communication strategy (CCS) for example. Different communication strategies may generate different impacts on consumers. However we can't ignore other factors that influence communication effects, such as consumer types. This paper uses consumer psychological contract (CPC) to distinguish the types of consumers and brand relationship quality (BRQ) to quantify crisis communication effects. We conducted a scenario-based experiment using beverage as stimulus and divided crisis communication strategies into three: apology, defense and compensation. The result showed that compensation is a better crisis communication strategy when consumer psychological contract is transactional;Communication strategies make no difference when consumer psychological contract is relational. CPC is identified as a moderator between the CCS and BRQ.

articleTitle: Marketing outsourcing risk assessment in the real estate based on risk matrix model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: With the rapid development of real estate market, more and more explorers prefer to choose the market outsourcing to speed up marketing and realize the rapid return of the capital. Risk will happen inevitably in the process of outsourcing. This paper summarizes and analyzes the risk produced in the process of real estate market outsourcing by using the qualitative research method of induction and deduction based on the life-cycle theory, constructs risk assessment model by using the risk matrix and Voting Theory. Taking a typical real estate marketing outsourcing project for example, it applies risk matrix model to assess the key risk. The result of assessment is conformed to the realistic situation, which means risk matrix model has strong practicability and provides the basis to the further risk control.

articleTitle: Tourism destination crisis management study—Based on the crisis life-cycle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Any threat to the safety of tourists causes a decrease or total absence of activity, not only in a particular tourism enterprise, but also very often in destinations, neighboring regions or countries as well. As the same as the marketing product life-cycle, tourism crisis also has life-cycle and shows different characteristics in diferent stages. This paper defines and explaines tourism crisis life-cycle, analyzes its characteristics in every stage. It also put forward some suggestions for tourism destination to deal with crisis exactly on the basis of crisis lifecycle, such as the pre-warning management in prodromal stage, responsing and mitigating management in acute and chronic stage, recovering management in resolution stage.

articleTitle: Network system security analysis based on game strategies graph
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: To solve the network security response problem, a novel network response decision-making method based on the two-matrix game model was present. We analyzed the attackers and system administrators' different strategies, and then constructed the dual-benefit matrix of the attackers and defenders. On the basis of this, the two-matrix network security game model was proposed. At last, the optimal defense strategy decision-making algorithm was proposed. Using this algorithm, we could analyze benefits of both offensive and defensive, and solved the Nash Equilibrium Point which balanced the both and gave the optimal response decision-making strategy. The proposed method could make accurate response decision and had a high efficiency. Also, it occupied a lower memory which could reduce the interference to normal user when administrators manage the network.

articleTitle: The application of the disaster losses macroscopic forecasting model in the rapid assessment after earthquak
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The rapid assessment of seismic losses currently is mainly based on two methods, which are construction damage matrix and macroeconomic dada based on the GDP. Compared with the building damage matrix method in data collection, the macro vulnerability assessment method based on GDP is easier, and it develops from the process of seismic losses in the global scale. This method can be used in the provincial-level administrative units of the small-scale earthquake damage assessment, there are still uncertainties. This paper analyses the application of the macro vulnerability assessment method in the provincial rapid assessment after an earthquake, by comparing model results with real expedition earthquake damage loss of data.

articleTitle: Thinking of China emergency construction of industrial standardization system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This paper describes the significance of the emergency rescue industry standardization, analyze the problems of China's emergency rescue industry and industry standardization, according to The four stages of disaster management <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>: prevention, preparedness, response, reconstruction, enhances social integration and rescue capabilities of the six areas ability. A new fourteen industrial system model is proposed, focusing on the development of comprehensive coordination between the systems. System fits national conditions and is operable. This paper also proposed two main tasks named start-up phase: education and training as a soft-start to wake up people's safety awareness. While security certification as a hard-start for a sound and healthy system. The implementation of hard and soft start to drive the development of other systems, making the emergency rescue industry demand from passive to active, promoting China's emergency rescue system to come out an industry standards, which will eventually promote a healthy development of the emergency rescue industry in China.

articleTitle: Public crisis management and government responsibility
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Management of public crisis is an important function of modern government. From the perspective of political science, public crisis management is a government responsibility. The author in the article attempts to explore the inherent causality between public crisis and government responsibility. On the one hand, the characteristics of public crisis determine the need of government responsibility; on the other hand, the essence and function of government determines the management of public crisis is its natural mission. Up to the reality, management of public crisis is an important function of modern government. Management capacity of public crisis is an important indicator to measure government competence, and reflects the comprehensive strength of every state. Therefore, it is significant to strengthen public crisis management for China experiencing rapid development and change.

articleTitle: The study of psychological crisis intervention after the earthquake disasters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: After the earthquake disasters, it often causes serious and pernicious influence, the influence is not only in materialterms loss, but also to the person's spirit and psychological traumatic. Due to the influence of the earthquake disasters, it will causes anxiety, panic and anxiety disorders and behavior psychological problems to the public. Social life is suddenly destroyed by the forces of nature, that causes the public crisis, then leads to the heart floating, seriously influence the public life order and the normal order of the social operation, thereby creates the situation of the production stagnation and social unrest. The government as an commander and main organizer to deal with the earthquake disasters, in the process of dealing with the problem after the earthquake disasters, not only needs to solve the problem of life and production in the area, the more important work is to handle the psychological crisis intervention work well, to help people who are hurt in the earthquake to overcome the fear in the heart. The psychological crisis intervention work after an earthquake disasters plays an important role in stabling the public mood after the earthquake disasters, and is the effective way to solve psychological crisis. This paper fully analyzed the characteristics of psychological crisis after the earthquake disasters, expounded the principles of psychological intervention that should be followed after the earthquake disasters, and a comprehensively and objectively put forward some strategies to solve the problems of psychological crisis after the earthquake disasters.

articleTitle: Agriculture drought hazard risk assessment in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: It is unusual inadequate precipitation that is the main factor leading to agriculture drought. The degree of precipitation deficit, the occurrence frequency and the duration are the main aspects for the quantitative calculation of drought hazard. China is a vast country with the complex and various types of landforms, and is affected by the significant monsoon climate, as result the farming activities are significant different over the country. In order to find out the comprehensively spatial differentiation of agricultural drought in a large area, this paper established a three-dimensional assessment model “I-P-L” for agriculture drought risk, where I,P,L means drought intensity, frequency, and length of duration respectively and drought is defined as the negative precipitation anomaly. daily data (from 1960 to 2009)of 535 meteorological stations in the recent 50 years was chosen for the drought risk calculation according to the water demand during the crop growing season, and the GIS technology was introduced into the risk mapping. The results showed that the Northwest, most of Inner Mongolia and Huang-Huai-Hai regions were of the high drought risk, while Tibet plateau and Sichuan Basin was lower. The agriculture hazard pattern has better tally with the drought centers got by many scholars, and can reflect the spatial differentiation of drought hazard. This paper can provide a scientific approach for the comprehensive hazards risk assessment and visual expression. This also can offer scientific proof to carry out risk evaluation and spatial, temporal pattern analysis on agricultural drought.

articleTitle: Risk assessment study of manufacturing green supply chain based on grey theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Since reform and opening up, in China, economy is developed rapidly, while economic system is increasingly build up sophisticated. But as nowadays we are promoting green and efficiency, part of the manufacturing enterprises in China are still in need of improvement. The operation of green supply chain is limited by many factors, faced a lot of uncertainty, so the manufacturing industry is facing a risk of fracture in green supply chain operation. This article is based on grey theory established a manufacturing risk evaluation model of green supply chain, and through the example analysis on supply chain to judge the risk of the individual members, sought to explore the development of green supply key links that are at risk, so as to provide reference on how to avoid risk appearing, improving the stability of running of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on food safety of China's food trade
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Food safety has become one of the world's most concerns. Foodborne diseases have become an important factor affecting public health.
