Biological and chemical substances pollution impact food safety more severely. The doubt of genetically modified (GM) foods safety did not eliminate. The China's food export has the problems, i.e. out of limits of pesticide residue, inconformity with regulations, out of limits of veterinary drug etc. This results from source pollution in agricultural production, food industry with low skills, lack of technological innovation, defect of food safety regulatory system, and lag of measurement technique etc. Therefore, a standardized and effective management procedure and food safety legal system needs establishing. Also the food safety standard compatible with international standards needs improving. Investment in agriculture production needs increased, and the quality of the producer and the producer's consuming awareness need improving.

articleTitle: Carbon neutral research of energy activities in City—For example in Harbin
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Carbon dioxide as the world's main greenhouse gas contribute to global climate warming is becoming more worse, this have threatened the survival of mankind. It's urgent to Reduce carbon emissions and increase carbon. Urban energy activities as a major global source of greenhouse gas emissions, has caused widespread concern. To achieve carbon neutral in earth, we must treat city as a key to reduce the urban-industrial, transportation and other industries carbon emissions, and enhance carbon sequestration from city construction materials, vegetation, carbon emissions trading and other areas, and ultimately achieve carbon-neutral in city. This is important to curb global warming. In this paper, we take Harbin for example, we chose energy consumption, respectively, and vegetation conditions as the basis to account the urban carbon footprint and carbon dioxide absorption, and predicted City carbon-neutral status by comparative analysis of two carbon-neutral city state. Finally, We took carbon-neutral measures to achieve the target of a preliminary exploration and made policy recommendations to achieve carbon-neutral in city, and provide a reference to improve the urban environment.

articleTitle: Research on emergency information management based on the social network analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In recent years, the emergency information management in cities has been one of the hot issues of study in the field of public emergency management. Based on the social network analysis, this article makes a study of the incident of the water pollution in Xin'anjiang River, an city emergency in china in 2011<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>. Setting up diagraphs of topology with the help of Ucinet software, the author calculates the density of network and the average distance in the whole network structure and also calculates point centrality, betweenness centrality, closeness centrality, etc. in the analysis of centrality. The author tries to seek effective ways of management on emergency information by using the analysis of this typical case as a breakthrough in study, in hopes of achieving the effective information management and control by multiple main bodies in the social network under complex circumstances and providing support for the government to make decisions in dealing with emergencies.

articleTitle: Risk communication system: Case studies of Fukushima accident
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Recognizing the important role of risk communication in handling accidents, the author was committed to study risk communication in a nuclear accident in a systematic perspective. Through reviewing risk communication literature, and considering the specific background of nuclear industry, the author identified several major categories of key audience/players in the communication progress. The author established a crisis communication assessment chart to identify the features of the communicator groups which were demonstrated in each crisis life cycle. The paper performed a case study research on the latest happened Fukushima accident. Major features of various communicators and the interaction of the players were carefully analyzed by presenting a risk communication system chart. The paper also proposed suggestions for operators how to apply communication as a tool to manage nuclear accidents.

articleTitle: Study on the forestry industrial cluster in Muling city
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Because of the space of centralization, can improve the division of labor, cooperation and industry competition ability within the region; reduce the cost between the company transactions. Industrial cluster has unparalleled advantages. The forestry industry cluster is the inevitable trend of forest industrial development. Muling of Heilongjiang province actively explores the development of forestry industry cluster. This paper use SWOT analysis method to analyze strengths, weaknesses, challenges and threats of developing forestry industry cluster in Muling, and build a modern forestry industry cluster development model of Muling, at last this paper put forward the following suggestions: increase the degree of government's guidance and support, enhance the function of forestry science research institutions, set up the complementary of enterprises and industry circulation mechanisms.

articleTitle: Thinking of China emergency rescue system of education and training
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: China is a disaster-prone country. Disasters happen around the year and cause huge losses to people's lives and their properties. A summary of the development of disaster factors will lead to a conclusion. That is, a lack of self-helped ability from disaster victims and capability to give in-time rescue from rescue personals, are the two key factors to minimize the losses. Losses due to a lack of proper knowledge from people, insufficient preparation before the disaster, misjudgments in identifying hazards, and unable to provide timely help are much greater than the losses caused by disaster itself. In order to reduce disasters and to minimize the losses to the limit, education and training of emergency rescue to the people at different levels so that people across the country are equipped with safety awareness and self-helped rescue ability is quite essential. This paper analyzes the existing issues in the emergency education and training system. Corrective strategies for the education and training of emergency rescue are also provided. To improve the community's six comprehensive rescue capacity <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, according to the four stages in disaster management <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. Three different levels of emergency education and training system have been proposed including academic study, short-term training, and public education. Public safety and disaster risk management to be approved by the State Education Commission as regular courses in the colleges, as part of the development plan, will provide a fundamental and theoretical basis to reduce disaster and to improve rescue skill. Emergency staff training can as an effective complement to professional rescue teams to play a major role in emergency rescue. That will initiate such training and education programs for the public and hence improve the rescue skill for most of the people in this community <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>.

articleTitle: Defects and development of catastrophe insurance in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Catastrophe refers to natural disasters that caused huge damages to people's lives and property. Catastrophe insurance is a form of insurance through which the risks caused by natural disasters like earthquakes, hurricanes, tsunamis, floods can be dispersed. In recent years, the importance of catastrophe insurance has brought to the forefront of many countries and the catastrophe insurance products and systems are improving as the enormous losses caused by catastrophic natural disasters. China's economic losses caused by natural disasters are also very serious, but there is no catastrophe insurance has been established. To establish an insurance as the basis?variety of social assistance and government financial support for disaster relief system is currently respond to important tasks of catastrophic natural disasters.

articleTitle: The analysis and strategy of influence factors on hidden dangers of safety production behavior based on the improved C-HIP model in the modern work mode of China's manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: With the continual improvement of the hardware reliability technique, there are fewer accidents caused directly by mechanical failure and more impacts of human factors on enterprises' safety production system. The research on influence factors on hidden dangers of safety production behavior is needed urgently in China's new organizational circumstances to enhance timeliness and accuracy of analyses of hidden dangers of safety production behavior in the teamwork situation, to help managers remove relevant hidden behavior hazards effectively and reduce the loss caused by accidents. In this paper, influence factors on hidden dangers of safety production behavior are analyzed comprehensively in the modern work mode of China's manufacturing industry, mainly including internal, external and team factors, with a combination of teamwork traits and improved C-HIP (Communication and Human-Information Processing) model from the perspective of individual information communication, processing and appropriate strategies and solutions are proposed.

Author Keywords: hidden dangers of safety production behavior

articleTitle: Seismic emergency organizational structure and technical support platform for 72-hour gold rescue time
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Earthquake is recognized as a great a natural disaster to mankind. The data released by Ministry of Civil Affairs is shown earthquakes had caused tremendous damages to China's economic and social developments. It is becoming a more and more important impact factor to public safety. The research on seismic emergency is one of the substantial areas in emergency management. At present, China's governments at all levels have established a number of emergency response agencies, and have developed emergency systems associated with them. Unfortunately, earthquakes are significantly different from other disasters, they occurred suddenly and the lack of information would cause highly uncertain incidents. Emergency response agencies and the systems can play an important role in recovery and rebuilding phase, but they have some limitation to the rescue of 72-hour gold time and high real-time processing. This paper proposes an organizational structure of seismic emergency agencies emphasizing on the rescue of 72-hour gold time, and the support system related to them, to reduce casualties and losses caused by earthquakes to the minimum and promote the efficiency of rescue.

articleTitle: The performance and prevention of credit risks of commercial banks in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Credit risk is not only the most important and oldest form of risk in the financial markets, but also the most decisive financial risk in the face of the economic subjects in the current market environment. It directly affects all aspects of modern economic, and also a country's macroeconomic policy-making and economic development, and it even affects the stability and coordination of the global economic. But in China, commercial banks with the flaws in their systems and their backward in management means are encountering serious credit risks. In this paper, through summarizing the credit of China's commercial banks and studying the root causes of these problems, some possible effective advices are put forward to resolve the credit risks of commercial banks.

articleTitle: A comprehensive analysis method for the economic impact of the extreme weather disasters: A CGE model approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: In recent years the extreme weather disasters are occurring more and more frequently, which caused a great impact on the economy. After comparing with 5 kinds of methods in the evaluation losses of natural disasters field, that is comprehensive evaluation model, econometric model, IO model, SAM model and CGE model, this paper contributes a comprehensive analysis strategy in condition of different situations. Further, CGE model has its advantage in systematic, structural, non-liner, quantitative and scenario analysis, then this paper focuses on simulation process for 4 stages of disasters responses, which are very-short run, short run, medium run and long run, and design the corresponding character of the closures, parameters and shocks. In the end, an example of how to estimate ice-snow disaster in Hunan province in 2008 is present.

articleTitle: Design of Emergency Command Mechanism and its application in natural disaster response
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Command mechanism is an indispensable component of emergency mechanism. The rational Command Mechanism is helpful to ensure the good effect and efficiency of emergency management. Mechanism design has been complete and feasible in economic analysis field, while the design of emergency mechanism is still lacking in previous study. This paper introduces the basic concepts and classification of command mechanism. Based on the detailed analysis of command systems and its effective task chain, Emergency Command Mechanism is designed on Computational Organization Theory. Besides, the evaluation and failure analysis of Command Mechanism is discussed briefly. The command mechanism in general natural disasters (such as hurricane, earthquake and tsunami etc.) is demonstrated by a case study.

articleTitle: Research on responding capacity assessment of city power emergency engineering management based on the third indicator connotation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: At practice level emergency responding capacity assessment of city power emergency management is the fundamental element of a scientific city power emergency management system. Based on the previous study on city power emergency responding assessment indicators system, the paper focuses on the third level indicator connotation and its function, integratedly using emergency responding assessment of new cross subjects. Thus this study goes further in research on the framework of city power emergency responding capacity assessment indicator system.

articleTitle: Study on collaboration performance between non-governmental organizations and governmental sectors in pubic crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Collaboration between non-profit organizations and governmental sectors of all levels in public crisis will exert a great influence on the performance of public crisis management. Through referring to foreign appraisal pattern for collaborative performance between organizations and sampling Oxfam Hong Kong for their performance in 5.12 earthquakes, this paper has conducted a genuine survey of collaboration between non-profit organizations and governmental sectors in public crisis management. And the survey demonstrates that while in 5.12 earthquakes there's been a favorable cooperation between Oxfam Hong Kong and governmental sectors of all levels concerning communication, commitment, equality, capability, trust and respect, which to some degree serves as a benchmark for collaboration performance between non-profit organizations and government in public crisis management.

articleTitle: Discussions about perfecting Chinese system of official accountability for mining disasters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Under the backgrounds of `law-based politics' and `active development of democratic politics' of China, issues related to accountability system for officials are becoming an important topic in this hotspots. Currently, in terms of mining disasters, a series of problems are still very common: a positive atmosphere of practicing accountability system for officials still has not been formed; laws and regulations used to support the accountability system for officials are still far away from mature; officials who should take responsibilities for mining disasters are not willing to take the blame and resign. To solve the problems mentioned above, some possible solutions are raised, such as intensifying the officials' consciousness of practicing the accountability system, building up the accountability system with laws and regulations, and completing relevant institutions and regulations to ensure the accountability of officials.

articleTitle: Spent fuel pool transient analysis under accident case and the flow establishment process of passive cooling system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Spent fuel pool is one of the important auxiliary equipments for nuclear reactor. In this paper, RELAP5 code was used as the research tool and the Daya Bay spent fuel pool was chosen as the analysis object. By the establishment of corresponding nodalizations, the paper eventually calculated the time spent fuel pool needed to reach boiling from steady state and the time to make water level falling until the exposure of spent fuel after the outside main cooling system was failure. Furthermore, the paper has also discussed the passive cooling system for spent fuel pool, and then an establishment program of outside passive cooling system after main cooling system's failure was proposed. The results showed that: when the main cooling system is failure, it would take a relative long time to make the pool water reach boiling from steady state. During that time, if some certain remedial measures are adopted, it will not result in spent fuel pool serious accident. And the calculation results of this paper can be the certain reference for spent fuel pool engineering design.

articleTitle: Study on enterprise patent early warning of core technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Core technology patent early warning is the key part of enterprise patent early warning. After introducing the importance of core technology, this paper analyzes the instance of the warning source and warning intelligence in different life cycle period about the core technology patent early warning according to technology life cycle theory, and divide the warning source to four dimensions: technology entering threat, technical position threat, technology value realization threat and technology direction changing threat. After that it suggests that there are three important factors determine the degree of core technology patent early warning, that are technology, market and environment. On the basis of that, this paper builds the evaluation indexes system of core technique patent early warning further, and appraises the patent early warning grade by extenics and suggests enterprise should judge the situation and take corresponding measures according to this degree at last.

articleTitle: Evaluation and promotion strategy research on information communication ability of public crisis under the background of public relations in the crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology and the development of the economic globalization, social is in an open system environment, in which government's image and executive force will be affected by internal and external factors and so on, so the crisis of public relations possible happens at any time, and the information communication of public crisis is an important link of the success of public relations in the crisis. Therefore, this paper established the evaluation index system of the information communication ability of public crisis through the use of statistical methods and application of scientific analysis method on basis of clarifying connotation of the information communication of public crisis. Finally put forward the strategy of improving information communication ability of public crisis.

articleTitle: On the government information publicity in earthquake calamity—Taking Qinghai Yushu Earthquake as example
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Government Information disclosure, as a wide range of issues, has a positive impact on the construction of socialist democratic politics and on government scientific decision-making to prevent the corruption of power. In the sudden public crisis, government's information disclosure is the key to effective government response to the incident. It will help the government to better safeguard social public security, protect the right to be well-informed for all citizens, effectively curb the spread of rumors, and create a good image of the government. Whether government information is timely, authentic or comprehensive is closely related to the government capability and efficiency of dealing with public crises, and even to the government's credibility and legitimacy.To start from the basics and theories of government information disclosure, this paper tries to set out the necessity and importance systematically in the public emergency by reference to the Chinese government's concrete actions in the earthquake in Yushu, Qinghai Province; and to summarize the lessons of government information disclosure learned from the earthquake.

articleTitle: The empirical research on the existential crisis on the basis of income levels of staff of the state-owned forest zone
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This research adopts stratified sampling with random sampling methods and uses household survey of one-to-one interview. It makes the large-scale continuous tracking study to estimate the income of 913 staff families which in state-owned forest zone of Heilongjiang Province and contrast the difference before and after the national nature forest protection program in 1997, 2004 and 2007. Based on the large-scale empirical investigation, this article uses SPSS statistical analysis system to analyze the current situation and problems of the staff income. And this article mainly proposes the strategies to improve the current existent situation of states-owned forest staff: via to develop the economy of forest zone to enlarge employment and reemployment; to change the employment conceptions, and to strengthen the training for professional skills; to perfect the reform of property and to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of staff; to enlarge the investment of productivity, to develop non-public sector economy and to increase the staff income.

articleTitle: Low carbon economy - A study on the emergency strategy of industrial system and consumption system transformation in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Facing the great challenge of global warming, major developed country and regions have achieved social consensus of developing low-carbon economy. Low-carbon economy will not only be the direction of the future world economic development structure, but also one of the new pillars of the world economy. To take a commanding point in the global economic competition, China needs to understand the serious damage of high carbon economy to ecosystem and environment, and to gradually establish an industrial system and consumption system in line with the low-carbon economy. It should formulate emergency management strategy, and lead the transformation of industries and consumption through economic means, for the development of the low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: National ecological ethic and contemporary environmental crisis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This article analyses the performance and main features of current environmental crisis, revealing the specific reasons for the environmental crisis, and proposed the ideological source of the environmental crisis is humanistic ideology. It summarizes the basic connotation of national ecological ethic by expounding the concept of ecological ethic, western ecological ethics, and Chinese traditional cultural ecological ethic and minority ecological ethic. That is, realize the harmonious state between man and himself, man and society, man and nature, admitted human's knowledge on the nature protection and moral agent responsibility, mastering the natural ecological law to set up harmonious and continual development between the people, society and nature. Finally, in the perspective of national ecological ethics analyzing the current environmental crisis, and proposes some suggestions about solutions of environmental crisis.

articleTitle: Bayesian network model for fast disaster assessment in unconventional emergencies management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Fast disaster assessment in unconventional emergences (UEs) is difficult due to the uncertainties and incomplete information. This article explores the use of Bayesian network (BN), which facilitates the quantification of uncertainties, for fast disaster assessment. To guide and discipline the development of BN model, we proposed a procedure that consisted of two modules divided by the occurrence of emergency. The procedure was illustrated by a High-casualty fire (HCF) assessment model that contained three subnetworks: the direct result of a HCF, an internet public opinion (IPO) and a decision support subnetwork. This model not only assesses the effects of HCF and corresponding IPO but also enables users to make decisions based on assessment results. The results suggest that the model can perform fast disaster assessment with incomplete information. Conditional probabilities and prior probabilities learned from historical data and expert elicitation can compensate for the shortage of information. Furthermore, the model provides useful information for choosing effective risk control options using sensitivity analysis.

articleTitle: An empirical research on influence factors of China's state-owned enterprises M&A financing risk
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: M&A is a common way of enterprises capital operation which can effectively achieve low cost and high speed expansion. As a kind of capital operation mode, M&A always relies on financing to get trade funds. However different financing ways of M&A have different financing risk. This article star on the problem of financing that China's state-owned enterprises M&A existed, and according to the data of China's state-owned enterprises M&A in 2009 do a empirical research on influence factors of China's state-owned enterprises M&A financing risk from profit ability, the biggest shareholder holding ratio, trade scale, business scale, growth ability, remuneration rate of investment and the capital structure. Research found that: Ownership concentration, enterprises growth and profit ability, trade scale b are direct proportion to risk of dispersive control and stock prices falling; the remuneration rate of investment, total price of trade and capital structure are direct proportion to the bankruptcy risk; the scale of enterprises is direct proportion to the default risk.

articleTitle: Post-disaster reconstruction and terror management in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Post-disaster reconstruction includes two aspects: material reconstruction and psychological reconstruction. We all know that people's behavior is controlled by their mental forces. So in a sense, we can consider the psychological reconstruction as a basic foundation of the material reconstruction. But the reality in the process of post-disaster reconstruction is that many people emphasize on the material reconstruction more often than psychological reconstruction. And psychological reconstruction does not receive a proper attention. This paper points out the importance of the psychological reconstruction in post-disaster reconstruction, and applies terror management theory to the psychological reconstruction. The article also introduces the development and application of the terror management theory in China, points out the limitations of terror management theory at present, and suggests its future development.

articleTitle: Research on derivative events for Chinese natural disasters based on the Apriori improved model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The article based on the Apriori improved model, combined with the related theory of natural disasters derivative events, analyzes the information data of the natural disaster in the last three years in China, and finally confirms 10 representative derivative events of natural disasters. Through analyzing and sorting, this paper checks the results based on minimum support and minimum confidence, and ultimately determines the relationship between different derivative events. By discussing the items that rank ahead with the high confidence in associated results of the 2-items, 3-items and 4-items, respectively, it could be confirmed that the correctness of association results, and reflected the efficiency of the Apriori improved algorithm. Therefore, individuals can use the results to forecast the possibility of related derivative events after natural disasters occurring, with the ultimate goal of improving the prediction system.

articleTitle: Risk analysis of collisions during FPSO offloading operations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Collisions are studied as the main risks of floating production, storage and offloading (FPSO) offloading operations in this paper. The large application of FPSO in offshore industry has highlighted the safety issues during offloading operation. Firstly, the research progress about offshore collisions and the related risk analysis methods are studied. Secondly, a compact analysis of collisions and near miss cases is done in order to identify the risk factors associated with the collisions. The results are illustrated using fault tree analysis method. Finally, qualitative analyses of collisions are discussed regarding excessive surge and horizontal oscillation based on the feature of FPSO operations in China seas. The status of FPSO with diverse relative positions is studied and the corresponding risk control measures are presented. The works herein are instructive for the operation process during FPSO offloading.

articleTitle: Some ponderation of the nuclear accident management in China after Fukushima calamity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This paper introduces some ponderation after Fukushima nuclear accident. Several typical disasters happened in china are introduced briefly. The nuclear accident is compared with these disasters detailed. Then the public characteristics of china near the nuclear power plant are analyzed, which have strong influence on the nuclear accident management. Later the present nuclear accident management method is explained. In the last part some suggestions especially for China are put forward. The key points of the paper are as follows: the nuclear accident is very typical and only earthquake is commensurable; the government should tell the truth to the public as soon as possible and completely, and set quick of effective measures; a numerical forecast center is necessary, which can supply numerical data to make the disaster disposal more reliable.

articleTitle: Study on emergent social security event management in social transition period in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Unexpected social security events are one of the important research topics in the field of crisis management. Science reasonable management can effectively reduce the hazards of crisis. The article, from perspective of crisis management and combining with the special social stage of social transition in China, studies the management of social security events. This text analyses the basic triggers of social security from the view of politics, economy, culture and nation in the present stage, and proposes that the best way to deal with the management of social security events is to establish modern crisis management system.

Author Keywords: the Modern System of Crisis Management

articleTitle: Study on the comprehensive risk assessment of offshore project based on BP neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: Due to the following characteristics of offshore program, such as one-time large-scale investment, comprehensive high-risk, long payback period, high uncertainty, high regional and political, the investors has been paid more and more attentions to the risk of offshore program. Combined with the characteristics of offshore program risk management, and with the use of BP neural network theory, this paper constructed “the Offshore Program Risk Comprehensive Assessment index system” and “Assessment Model”. Combined with BP network learning process, and on the basis of selecting risk-related parameters and setting different network training layers, this paper simulated the BP model and analyzed the results.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Output Layer

articleTitle: Performance assessment and mechanism of rewards and punishment in emergency management for government
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: This paper discussed the performance assessment and mechanism of rewards and punishment in emergency management for emergency response department and responsible department. Firstly, the characters of performance assessment for emergency management differing from other public management were analyzed. Secondly,]performance assessments for emergency management were built. For emergency response department, the assessment was divided into four types based on both result factors and process factors and the model was then built. Responsible department was divided into construction department and emergency-causing department. For construction department, the assessment was divided into four types based on both result factors and construction quality factors and the model was then built. For emergency-causing department, the assessment was also divided into four types based on both result factors and human factors and the model was then built. Thirdly, the executive department for performance assessment was discussed. Finally, the mechanism of rewards and punishment was researched according to the results of performance assessment. Some principles were discussed for different department and different assessment results.

articleTitle: CFD simulation of the thermal-hydraulic characteristics within spent fuel storage pool
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The spent fuel rods unloaded from reactor core have massive decay heat and are temporarily stored in the spent fuel pool. It is important for the safety operation of nuclear power plant to determine whether it has proper capability to remove the decay heat. The objective of the present study is to research the residual heat removal ability of spent fuel pool under various unloaded scenarios and influences of various arrangements of inlet pipe. CFD methodology was applied to develop a tool for spent fuel pool thermal hydraulic analysis. The heat transfer at the interface air/liquid was modeled by using effective heat transfer coefficient, which was attained by considering the heat transfer including the natural convection of the air and the vapor of hot water. Results show that the arrangement of the inlet pipe located at the bottom of the spent fuel storage pool, considering the capacity of removing decay heat, is superior to all other arrangements. Both under normal conditions and even more severe scenarios, cooling system can remove the remaining residual heat and the peak temperature locates at the top region of spent fuel storage rack. There exit strong natural circulation, which enhances the flow and heat transfer process in the storage pool. The present studies are of great significance and can provide valuable references for the design and optimization of spent fuel storage pool.

articleTitle: Comprehensive methods of cost-benefit analysis of emergency management on natural hazards
publicationTitle: Proceedings of International Conference on Information Systems for Crisis Response and Management (ISCRAM)
abstract: The cost and benefit of investment in the prevention and mitigation of natural disasters need to be assessed and measured before and after the capital input, for the pursuit of maximized benefit within minimized cots. Since quite a few mitigation projects failed to meet the needs of efficiency and effectiveness, causing a huge waste of resources, this paper aims to study on the cost and benefit analysis of two main elements in the process of natural disaster prevention and mitigation-the operation of the emergency response organization and the mitigation infrastructures, introducing the general and comprehensive methods of cost and benefit assessment to provide certain positive theoretical contribution to the investment decision-making of the emergency management.
